title: TF Regression Code Along - Data Preprocessing and Creating a Model

cues.en: (tranquil music)
cues.zh: （平靜音樂）

cues.en: Instructor: Welcome back, everyone to part two or our second phase of the Keras regression code along project.
cues.zh: 講師：各位，歡迎回到 Keras 迴歸實作專案的第二部分，或說第二階段。

cues.en: We've already taken a look at the features, done a little bit of feature engineering and even dropped some features.
cues.zh: 我們已查看特徵、做了一些特徵工程，也刪除部分特徵。

cues.en: Now it's time to scale along for train_test_split and then create a model and train the model.
cues.zh: 現在要進行 train_test_split、縮放資料，再建立並訓練模型。

cues.en: Let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Okay, after we finish all our feature engineering, the next step is to separate our features from our label and we can do this by assigning X
cues.zh: 完成所有特徵工程後，下一步是把特徵與標籤分開，讓 X，

cues.en: to df.drop price along axis equal to one.
cues.zh: 等於 df.drop，沿 axis=1 刪除 price。

cues.en: And then the other thing we're going to do is say Y is equal to df.price and to make sure there's no issues between the pandas data types and the NumPy numerics,
cues.zh: 另外讓 Y 等於 df.price；為了避免 pandas 資料型別和 NumPy 數值資料之間出現問題，

cues.en: we can also just request the values.
cues.zh: 也可以直接取得 values。

cues.en: So if you say .values, this returns back the NumPy array underneath the actual DataFrames, our panda series.
cues.zh: 使用 .values，就會傳回 DataFrame 或 pandas Series 底層的 NumPy 陣列。

cues.en: So we run those and now that we have separated our features from our label, it's time to do a train_test_split.
cues.zh: 執行後，特徵和標籤已分開，接著進行 train_test_split。

cues.en: We will say from sklearn.model_selection.
cues.zh: 使用 from sklearn.model_selection，

cues.en: Import a train_test_split, run that.
cues.zh: 匯入 train_test_split，然後執行。

cues.en: And the way I like to do this to save myself a little bit of typing time is just grab the example from the doc string and copy and paste it in here.
cues.zh: 為了少打一些字，我喜歡直接從文件字串複製範例，貼到這裡。

cues.en: So we'll just go ahead and grab that, copy it, paste it in.
cues.zh: 選取範例、複製、貼上。

cues.en: I would encourage you to do the same.
cues.zh: 我也建議你這樣做。

cues.en: And what I'm going to do is I'm going to set my test size to just be 30% and I'll also set my random state to be 101.
cues.zh: 把 test_size 設成 30%，random_state 設為 101。

cues.en: Again, arbitrary number choice.
cues.zh: 這個數字同樣是隨意選的。

cues.en: It's just that we're consistent across the notebook.
cues.zh: 只是要讓整份筆記本保持一致。

cues.en: So go ahead and choose the same random state I do.
cues.zh: 所以請選擇和我相同的 random_state。

cues.en: That way you can compare your results directly.
cues.zh: 這樣就能直接比較結果。

cues.en: Okay, so we'll go ahead and run this.
cues.zh: 好，執行。

cues.en: We've done our split.
cues.zh: 已經完成切分。

cues.en: Now it's time to actually perform the scaling.
cues.zh: 現在真正進行縮放。

cues.en: Remember, we wanna do the scaling post-split.
cues.zh: 請記得，縮放要在切分之後。

cues.en: That way we only fit to the training set to prevent data leakage from the test set.
cues.zh: 這樣只會對訓練集擬合，避免測試集資料洩漏。

cues.en: We'll do this just as we've done before by saying sklearn.preprocessing, import MinMaxScaler.
cues.zh: 和之前一樣，從 sklearn.preprocessing 匯入 MinMaxScaler。

cues.en: You can technically use any scaling you like but MinMaxScaler is simpler to understand.
cues.zh: 你其實可以選擇任何縮放方法，但 MinMaxScaler 比較容易理解。

cues.en: So we'll use it in this case, MinMaxScaler.
cues.zh: 所以這裡使用 MinMaxScaler。

cues.en: And then we will redefine our training set as the scaled versions.
cues.zh: 再把訓練集重新設定成縮放後的版本。

cues.en: And I can save a little bit of time by both fitting and transforming on my training set in one step.
cues.zh: 我可以一步完成訓練集的擬合與轉換，節省一些時間。

cues.en: So previously, we saw us fit and transform in two steps but scaling actually has this convenience feature of transforming and then fitting at one step.
cues.zh: 之前我們分兩步做 fit 和 transform，但縮放器提供便利功能，可以一次完成轉換與擬合。

cues.en: So we'll go ahead and do that.
cues.zh: 所以我們就這樣做。

cues.en: And then for the test set, recall here, we're just going to transform.
cues.zh: 測試集這裡則只做 transform，還記得吧。

cues.en: We don't fit to our test set because we don't want to assume prior information about our test set.
cues.zh: 不對測試集擬合，因為不想事先取得測試集的資訊。

cues.en: So there's our training set and there's our test set.
cues.zh: 這裡是訓練集，這裡是測試集。

cues.en: Now they've been scaled.
cues.zh: 現在都已縮放。

cues.en: Coming up next, what we're gonna do is actually create the model.
cues.zh: 接著就是真正建立模型。

cues.en: So we'll do the following.
cues.zh: 做法如下。

cues.en: We'll say from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential
cues.zh: 使用 from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential，

cues.en: and then we'll also say from tensorflow.keras.layers import.
cues.zh: 再使用 from tensorflow.keras.layers import，

cues.en: And we're going to import a Dense layer.
cues.zh: 匯入 Dense 層。

cues.en: So we run that and let's create our model.
cues.zh: 執行後建立模型。

cues.en: So we create a sequential model, and typically what we do is we try to base the number of neurons or units in our layers from the size of the actual feature data.
cues.zh: 建立 Sequential 模型，通常會根據實際特徵資料的大小，決定層內神經元或單元的數量。

cues.en: So let's take a quick look at the shape of our data.
cues.zh: 快速看一下資料形狀。

cues.en: So it looks like we have 19 incoming features and that's probably a good range to then have 19 neurons in our layer.
cues.zh: 看起來有 19 個輸入特徵，因此層內使用 19 個神經元應該是個不錯的起點。

cues.en: So say model.add Dense 19.
cues.zh: 所以使用 model.add，加入 Dense(19)。

cues.en: And we'll also say that the activation layer will be a rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: 激活函數也設定成整流線性單元。

cues.en: Now let's make sure we actually spell this correctly.
cues.zh: 確認拼字正確。

cues.en: Sequential.
cues.zh: 是 Sequential。

cues.en: Now, something that we're going to explore later on is to see how we can use early stopping in order to try to choose the correct number of epochs to train for
cues.zh: 稍後會探討如何透過提前停止，選擇適當的訓練 epoch 數，

cues.en: but also to try to choose the correct number of layers to train for.
cues.zh: 也試著選擇合適的訓練層數。

cues.en: For right now though, I'm just going to copy and paste this line a couple of times to add in and make this a deep learning network.
cues.zh: 不過現在先把這行複製貼上幾次，加入更多層，形成深度學習網路。

cues.en: Now, this may be overkill and we may end up overfitting slightly to the training data but we'll be able to explore whether or not that's happening by passing in validation data along with our training.
cues.zh: 這可能有些過度，甚至稍微過度擬合訓練資料，但可以在訓練時傳入驗證資料，檢查是否發生這種情況。

cues.en: So what I will do here is add one more final layer
cues.zh: 接著再加入最後一層，

cues.en: and this last final layer is just gonna have one neuron as its output, since that's going to be directly outputting our predicted price.
cues.zh: 最後這層只有一個輸出神經元，因為它會直接輸出預測價格。

cues.en: And then we are going to compile this model.
cues.zh: 然後編譯模型。

cues.en: And previously in the theory sections of these lectures, we went ahead and talked about Adam optimizer being a good optimizer.
cues.zh: 在先前的理論課程中，我們提過 Adam 是很好的最佳化器。

cues.en: So we'll choose it by passing in the string code adam.
cues.zh: 所以傳入字串 adam 來選擇它。

cues.en: And since this is a regression problem, we're choosing a continuous label, such as price.
cues.zh: 因為這是迴歸問題，要預測像價格這樣的連續型標籤，

cues.en: We'll go ahead and choose our loss metric as mean squared error.
cues.zh: 損失指標就選擇均方誤差。

cues.en: Okay, so we go ahead and run that and now it's time to train the model.
cues.zh: 好，執行，現在可以訓練模型了。

cues.en: We'll say model.fit.
cues.zh: 呼叫 model.fit。

cues.en: And then what I'm going to pass here is my training data, just as we've done before.
cues.zh: 和之前一樣，這裡傳入訓練資料。

cues.en: So X_train and then y_train.
cues.zh: 就是 X_train 和 y_train。

cues.en: And the next thing I'm going to do is also pass in validation data.
cues.zh: 接著也傳入驗證資料。

cues.en: If we do Shift + Tab here, you'll notice that you can pass in the data to train on X and Y, and you can also pass in validation data.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Tab，可以看到除了訓練用的 X 和 Y，也能傳入 validation_data。

cues.en: And what that means is after each epoch of training on the training data, we'll quickly run the test data and check our loss on the test data so that way we can keep a tracking
cues.zh: 意思是每次用訓練資料完成一個 epoch 後，會快速跑過測試資料，檢查測試損失，以便持續追蹤，

cues.en: of how we're performing not just on our training data but also on our test data.
cues.zh: 模型在訓練資料和測試資料上的表現。

cues.en: Keep in mind, this test data will not actually affect the weights or biases of our network.
cues.zh: 請注意，這些測試資料不會實際影響網路的權重或偏置。

cues.en: So Keras isn't going to update your model based off the test data or validation data.
cues.zh: 所以 Keras 不會根據測試資料或驗證資料更新模型。

cues.en: Instead, it will only use the training data as it's updating the weights and biases and continue to essentially check how well it's doing on not just the training data, but also the validation data.
cues.zh: 更新權重與偏置時只會使用訓練資料，並持續檢查模型在訓練資料及驗證資料上的表現。

cues.en: And the way we pass this in is by saying validation_data is equal to and then we pass in our values here.
cues.zh: 傳入方式是設定 validation_data，然後放入資料值。

cues.en: So we're going to say X_test and then y_test.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 X_test 和 y_test。

cues.en: And we wanna make sure that we actually consider the values here.
cues.zh: 也要確認這裡實際使用的是數值。

cues.en: So something you have to make sure of is that you call .values here because TensorFlow may complain if you don't pass in a numeric array because it can't work with pandas series or DataFrames that well.
cues.zh: 必須記得呼叫 .values，因為若沒有傳入數值陣列，TensorFlow 可能會報錯，它對 pandas Series 或 DataFrame 的支援沒那麼好。

cues.en: So make sure you've done the values and as again, what we're doing here is we're training on X_train, y_train but as we go along, we wanna be checking against our test set
cues.zh: 所以確認已取得 values；再說一次，我們用 X_train、y_train 訓練，同時持續與測試集比較，

cues.en: and that will give us some nice plots to basically realize whether or not we're overfitting.
cues.zh: 這樣就能得到圖形，了解是否過度擬合。

cues.en: So add in the validation data.
cues.zh: 所以加入驗證資料。

cues.en: And finally, because this is a larger dataset, we're gonna feed in our data in batches.
cues.zh: 最後，因為這是較大的資料集，我們會分批輸入資料。

cues.en: And we're gonna call batch_size of 128.
cues.zh: batch_size 設為 128。

cues.en: It's very typical to do batch_sizes in powers of two.
cues.zh: batch_size 通常使用二的次方。

cues.en: The smaller the batch_size, the longer training is going to take but the less likely you're going to overfit to your data because you're not passing in
cues.zh: 批次越小，訓練時間越長，但比較不容易過度擬合，因為沒有一次把，

cues.en: your entire training set at once.
cues.zh: 整個訓練集全部傳入。

cues.en: Instead, you're focusing on these smaller batches.
cues.zh: 而是著重這些較小的批次。

cues.en: And then finally, let's go ahead and choose kind of an arbitrary large number of epochs.
cues.zh: 最後先隨意選一個比較大的 epoch 數。

cues.en: We don't have any early stopping mechanisms yet.
cues.zh: 目前還沒有提前停止機制。

cues.en: We'll learn about those later on in the course but for right now, we'll do 400.
cues.zh: 本節後面會學，但現在先跑 400。

cues.en: That way I can see those nice curves and also, compare my training performance to my test performance.
cues.zh: 這樣能看見漂亮的曲線，也能比較訓練和測試表現。

cues.en: So go ahead and run this and hopefully if you've done everything correctly, you should be getting to see the output.
cues.zh: 執行，如果步驟都正確，應該就會看到輸出。

cues.en: If you get some sort of error code here, make sure you reference our notebook and you can go ahead and run our notebook directly in order to prevent any simple typo errors.
cues.zh: 如果這裡報錯，請參考課程筆記本，也可以直接執行筆記本，避免單純的拼字錯誤。

cues.en: Okay, so this is training on our dataset right now.
cues.zh: 好，現在正在用資料集訓練。

cues.en: Coming up in the next lecture, we'll go ahead and finish this training.
cues.zh: 下一堂課會讓訓練完成。

cues.en: So we'll kind of fast forward through this and then we'll start evaluating on our test dataset, as well as predict on brand new data.
cues.zh: 我們會快轉這段過程，再開始評估測試集，也對全新資料進行預測。

cues.en: So again, all we've done in this lecture is we've scaled our data after doing the train_test_split, created our model.
cues.zh: 再說一次，這堂課做的是在 train_test_split 之後縮放資料，並建立模型。

cues.en: And then kind of the new thing that we saw here is adding in validation data during the fitting, as well as choosing a batch_size.
cues.zh: 新介紹的內容，則是在 fit 時加入驗證資料，以及設定 batch_size。

cues.en: Okay, thanks, and I'll see you at the next lecture.
cues.zh: 好，謝謝，下堂課見。
